name: aidevobserver
description: Review the active AI-session transcript for reinvention / waste findings via the AI Done Right byo_demo_server (bring your own key, used transiently).

aidevobserver.apiKey.markdownDescription: Bring-your-own API key. Sent as `byo_key` with each review request and used transiently by the endpoint for that one call only. The extension does not persist or log it beyond this VS Code setting.

aidevobserver.endpoint.description: URL of the byo_demo_server /run endpoint that receives the {demo, byo_key, inputs} payload and returns the review JSON.
